title: Inheritance Tax: application for a clearance certificate (IHT30)
text:
Use form IHT30 to apply for a clearance certificate, showing you have paid all the Inheritance Tax due. You can only apply when you believe all the inheritance tax due has been paid.

 Email HMRC to  ask for this form in Welsh (Cymraeg) .
changeNote: The formatting in the section "Date of amendments to the account" has been updated in the IHT30 form.
